{{Quote|We ''do '' set course for a port where we can get what we need. Say, Parabaw Station, a smugglers' haven here in the Outer Rim.|Turman Durra|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Parabaw Station''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that was located in the [[Jospro sector/Legends|Jospro sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was used as a holding station for troops and supplies before all of the station's [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and troops went out to help against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. After that, Parabaw Station was used for holding supplies for those who needed it until it was accidentally destroyed due to some major malfunctions.<ref name="MK" />
